safety_tips.tip: Avoid sidewalk restaurants unless they are known for their veg or chicken/seafood options
Avoid nighttime travel in remote or poorly lit areas, especially outside Hoi An or Son Tra
Avoid isolated beach areas after dark
Keep valuables in crossbody bags or money belts in crowded areas
Avoid carrying passports daily; carry copies instead
Use hotel safes for passports, cash and jewelry
Stick to well-lit areas at night
